device.name: Tektronix BERTScope bit error rate analyzer (sindri.tektronix.bertscope:BERTScope_TCP)

facts.text: The clone implements the Tektronix BERTScope Bit Error Rate Analyzers and lists the BA1500, BA1600, BSA85C, BSA125A, BSA125B, BSA125C, BSA175C, BSA220C, BSA250C, BSA260C and BSA286C models
idn queries *IDN?; the response is user configurable, so the clone does not parse it
reset sends *RST to set the instrument functions to the factory default power up state
run sends RST 1 to start all systems and stop sends RST 0 to stop all systems within the BERTScope mainframe
is_running queries RST? and returns 1 while the mainframe runs
run_duration is in seconds with the limits 0 to 36E6; setting it to 0 lets the run go on forever
get_internal_temperature queries SENS:TEMP? and returns degrees Celsius; the clone says the measurement is not calibrated and is only a relative indication
detector_reset_results sends DET:RRES to reset the error detector results
get_detector_bit_count queries DET:BITS? for the total bits detected and get_detector_error_count queries DET:ERR? for the total errors detected during the run
get_detector_bit_error_rate queries DET:BER? for the computed bit error rate based on run results
get_detector_elapsed_time queries DET:ETIM? for the elapsed seconds since the last reset and get_detector_resyncs queries DET:RESY? for the resync count
get_detector_error_free_bits_count queries DET:EFB? for the latest error-free bit count and get_detector_error_free_time queries DET:EFT? for the latest error-free time
BERTScope_TCP mixes the BERTScope core, Mainframe and Detector features with the IEEE 488.2 subset and a TCP transport
